notes.title: Mac and Steamdeck versions available now!
notes.content:
[b]Mac OSX and Native Steamdeck are out!!![/b]

YESSSSSSSSSS

they're out!!

[i]hi![/i]

super excited to announce that Tails Noir: Rebel Rush is available on [b]Mac OSX[/b] and as a [b]Native Steamdeck[/b] build starting from now!

we checked from our side and made sure that all achievements are achieving, leaderboards are working, and cloud saves are saving too!

[b]steamdeck [/b] players, take a note:

1. we're verifying the game with Steam, but it is not verified yet
2. it means that for now steamdeck will try to download the windows build
3. but what you really need is the linux build
4. so you need to go to the game properties and select [b]"force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool"[/b]

should look like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079386/e874eba05abe2a74d7ea9a7c3e6662786034832a.jpg[/img]

drop us a line at discord if you have any questions!

[i]enjoy,
dima[/i]

notes.title: Tails Noir: Rebel Rush day two patch update notes
notes.content:
[b]update notes for build v. 3.2.3[/b]

[list]
[*] more [b]reliable himbos[/b]! fixed a glitchy himbo behavior when they pulled the car to the side
[*] [b]fewer road bumps[/b]! fixed road stitches causing car to get stuck
[*] [b]better dialogues[/b]! fixed rare issues with font displays
[*] [b]quality of life[/b] improvements! now in "rebel rush" mode music changes depending on the chapter of the game
[/list]

no changes in levels or level layouts, nothing that can affect leaderboard scores

[i]hope you're having fun!!
dima,
soup with friends[/i]

notes.content:
